entries.1c99a9f8a064b41b: This reporting segment develops and sells the printer control system software "Mistral" for printer manufacturers that supply specialty and industrial printers, and sells printer control devices incorporating Mistral, and provides maintenance and customer support. Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥243 million.

entries.7b2d47417d50cc3d: This reporting segment develops and sells software and solutions that prevent information leaks, and remote monitoring software compatible with IP surveillance cameras from various manufacturers. Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥613 million.
entries.81dfc3550c9bbc62: A company that develops and sells control software for special and industrial printers, and security software for preventing information leaks, remote monitoring and other purposes.
entries.993ebafbe1aff87b: This field develops and sells the network remote monitoring software "FIREDIPPER," compatible with IP cameras from various manufacturers, and performs integration development for system installation and construction. It also develops and sells image analysis using AI technology and image conversion servers using modular embedded computers.
entries.b4c4c016213c390d: This is a segment not included in reportable segments, covering contract development and other activities. It received a commission from the University of Tokyo to develop a dedicated board for quantum measurement and radiation measurement research. Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥44 million.
entries.c06ca7c1fc995847: This reporting segment conducts sales activities to introduce the library system "MnemosNEXT," which stores data long-term using multiple volumes of LTO tape media. Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥8 million.
entries.c737a446d97b05b3: This field provides the secure print solution "SPSE," which integrates functions to reduce ink and toner use and to collect, inspect and audit documents output to printers and copiers; "TCCM," which controls printers on client PCs; "PC GUARD," which restricts PC use and encrypts data; and "COPY GUARD," which prevents unauthorized use and copying of software.
